sources.snippet: The Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is a state-of-the-art multilingual language model with 7 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. This is based on the implementation of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.snippet: On 24 March 2025, Alibaba launched Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct as a successor to the Qwen2.5-VL model. It was released under the Apache 2.0 license. [25][26] On 26 March 2025, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B was released under the Apache 2.0 license and made available through chat.qwen.ai, as well as platforms like Hugging Face, GitHub, and ModelScope.
